title: Cloud Inventory Discovery Foundation
goal: Add the first read-only cloud inventory discovery slice while preserving the existing approval-aware runtime and inventory model.
scope: Implement one read-only cloud inventory provider slice, preferably AWS first unless a future active task explicitly selects another provider, collecting limited account/resource metadata into existing inventory structures. Do not perform exploitation, mutation, credential harvesting, or cloud-to-on-prem attack chaining.
generation_reason: Backlog refresh requested by the project owner after the previous queue ended at backlog item 10.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Implement one read-only cloud inventory slice only. Defer IAM attack paths, mutation, exploitation, Kubernetes, and multi-cloud expansion.
notes: Cloud credentials must use protected secret binding patterns.
Inventory output must reuse existing inventory/report surfaces before adding new surfaces.

success_criteria: One cloud provider read-only discovery path is implemented or made decision-complete for implementation.
Collected resources normalize into existing inventory structures or documented additive fields.
The run profile and task planning remain approval-aware and scoped.
No cloud resources are modified, exploited, or chained into active attack paths.
Tests cover deterministic fixture output and unsafe/missing-credential behavior.
must_not_touch: pack registry and runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: The provider slice is read-only and scoped.
Inventory is evidence-backed and visible through existing surfaces.
No cloud mutation or exploitation is possible in this slice.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
A single provider and read-only resource boundary are selected.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with cloud discovery changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the cloud inventory baseline and remaining cloud risks.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
